metric_definitions.visitors_daily: Unique (client_ip, user_agent) pairs per WAT calendar day; GET, HTTP 200, page paths only (excludes /_next, /api/, static assets, RSC/prefetch requests, bot-like UAs). Not people; not deduped across days.
metric_definitions.visitors_total_line: visits.sh 'total' row SUMS daily uniques across days, so it is NOT distinct visitors over the window.
metric_definitions.page_views: Count of qualifying GET 200 page requests per WAT day.
metric_definitions.top_pages: Computed over the whole script window (default 7 days), not per day.
metric_definitions.db_counts: Cumulative table row counts at a point in time (snapshot), not daily activity.
